tool_library.name: legal
tool_library.description: List legal UCI moves grouped as captures, checks and quiet moves. This does not play a move.

tool_library.name: hanging
tool_library.description: Show capture threats, legal recaptures and local material loss. Pinned geometric defenders do not prove safety. This is not a full exchange search.

tool_library.name: king
tool_library.description: Report in-check status, castling rights and castling moves legal now. Not in check does not mean safe.

tool_library.name: material
tool_library.description: Count pieces and approximate material balance. Material is not a position evaluation.

tool_library.name: preview
tool_library.description: Choose a legal candidate to try without playing it. Inspect captures of the moved piece, material consequences, opponent mate-in-one and terminal draws. No engine or best-move recommendation.

tool_library.name: piece
tool_library.description: Finish lookups, choose a piece, then choose one of its legal moves.
